{{Infobox Euroleague Player | name = Nicolas Batum | nickname = | image = Nicolas batum tournoi douai 2007 06 10.JPG | caption = | position = [[Small forward]] | height_ft = 6 | height_in = 8 | weight_lb = 210 | league = | team = [[Le Mans Sarthe Basket]] | nationality = France | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1988|12|14}} | birth_place = [[Lisieux]], [[France]] | highschool = | college = | draft = | draft_year = 2008 | draft_team = | career_start = 2005 | career_end = | former_teams = | awards = 2006 Albert Schweitzer Tournament MVP }} '''Nicolas Batum''' (born [[December 14]] [[1988]] in [[Lisieux]][http://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/breves2007/20070408_210510Dev.html Nicolas Batum at the Nike Hoop Summit, ''lequipe.fr'']) is a [[France|French]] [[basketball]] player. He is considered one of the most talented young players in Europe[http://www.draftexpress.com/player_rankings.php?r=17 Ranking of international players born in 1988, ''draftexpress.com''] and a possible [[NBA draft|NBA draft lottery pick]][http://www.nbadraft.net/2007hoopsummit002.asp Batum's evaluation at the 2007 Nike Hoop Summit, ''nbadraft.net'']. He was voted the most valuable player in the U18 [http://www.ast-basketball.de Albert Schweitzer Tournament] in Mannheim 2006. The 6 ft 8 in (2.03 meter) Batum primarily plays the [[small forward]] position, although he is also capable of shifting to the shooting guard position.[http://nicolas-batum.blogspot.com/2008/06/nicolas-batum-in-nba-draft.html Nicolas Batum NBA Draft Profile, ''http://nicolas-batum.blogspot.com''] He delivered an impressive performance[http://usabasketball.com/men/2007/07_mhs_game-story.html 2007 Nike Hoops Summit recap, ''usabasketball.com''] at the 2007 Nike Hoop Summit[http://usabasketball.com/men/2007/07_mhs_box.html 2007 Nike Hoop Summit, ''usabasketball.com''] scoring 23 points (9/13 FG, 3/5 for 3 pts) in 28 minutes. He also grabbed four rebounds and recorded four steals. ==Career== ===French youth teams=== Batum won the ''2004 FIBA European Championship'' with the French National Team. The French team repeated as champion in the ''2005 European Championship''. Batum won the most valuable player award. ====Albert Schweitzer Tournament==== {{Cleanup|date=June 2007}} Batum was named the most valuable player of the 2006 U18 Albert Schweitzer Tournament in Mannheim.
